title_alternatives: Your Wedding Costs Way More Than $35,000

youtube_short.description: The average American wedding costs $35,000. But that's not the real price — invest that same money at 7% for 30 years and you're looking at $266,000. Americans spend 3x the global average on weddings, and 1 in 5 couples even borrows to do it. This video breaks down the actual opportunity cost of the average American wedding and what that money could fund instead. #personalfinance #investing #weddingplanning #moneypsychology #financialfreedom — Follow for more money moves they don't teach you in school.
